description:
Get adverse event profile for a target from OpenFDA data.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table openfda_significant_adverse_target_reactions — one record = one FAERS adverse event significantly reported for drugs acting on one target.
Key: targetId, event.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by llr desc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. openFDA FAERS events with llr above the critical value for drugs on this target; FAERS target signals exist only for targets of marketed drugs; absence means not significant or not reported and is not evidence of safety.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
